title: Uniform first-order approximation of a C^1 map near a point
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, let U ⊆ R^n = EuclideanSpace R (Fin n) be open, let u : R^n → R^l be of class C^1 on U (ContDiffOn R 1 u U), let x0 ∈ U and ε > 0. Then there is η > 0 such that the closed ball B_η(x0) is contained in U and |u(x) - u(y) - Du(x0)(x - y)| <= ε |x - y| for all x, y ∈ B_η(x0), where Du(x0) = fderiv R u x0 and |·| are the Euclidean norms.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u U → ∀ x₀ ∈ U, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ closedBall x₀ η ⊆ U ∧ ∀ x ∈ closedBall x₀ η, ∀ y ∈ closedBall x₀ η, ‖u x - u y - fderiv ℝ u x₀ (x - y)‖ ≤ ε * ‖x - y‖
